notes.title: Enypnion Update
notes.notes:
Hi friends,

We are very glad to announce that first of all we are alive and well, still developing games, and that we have an important update for Enypnion!

What's this update about? Well, first of all, we fixed a couple of minor bugs and a few typos in the game.
The important feature of the update is that we have also included some extra content.  

Players will find a couple of extra puzzles that were not present in the original version of the game. We are thrilled with people liking the game and commenting that they wish it would be a bit longer. Well, we decided that it would be cool to work on something while we wanted a break from the Mike & Tyler development (which is a bit delayed but still moving forward) 

Who knows, we may add some extra content again in the future!

The downside of this is that the new game breaks compatibility with older save files. Saves still load but various elements do not work as intended (music for example). 

We like to believe that the update is worth the sacrifice though.

Thanks a lot and don't forget to support Indie teams by leaving a review on the store.
